knowledge_units.context_summary: The study investigates SU(2)-invariant nearest-neighbor valence-bond wavefunctions on the square lattice using Monte Carlo simulations. It finds that four-point correlations decay algebraically with an exponent of 1.16(4) and are spatially modulated by wave-vectors linked to topological invariants. The authors conclude that a specific spin Hamiltonian stabilizing these states should have gapped spin and gapless non-magnetic excitations.

knowledge_units.context_summary: The study employs an efficient Monte Carlo algorithm combining non-local dimer updates and spin updates to simulate nearest-neighbor valence-bond wavefunctions on square lattices up to size L=128. Nearest-neighbor spin correlations converge to a value of -0.295953(7) in the thermodynamic limit, exhibiting short-range staggered order with a correlation length of 1.35(1).

knowledge_units.context_summary: The study analyzes the dimer order parameter and angular dependence of nearest-neighbor valence-bond wavefunctions on a square lattice to determine their symmetry. Monte Carlo simulations indicate that the system exhibits continuous U(1) symmetry rather than discrete columnar or plaquette order. The authors predict that the corresponding Hamiltonian hosts gapped spin excitations and gapless non-magnetic excitations, characterizing a gapped U(1) or SU(2) spin liquid.
